description: Sanitized manifest for Step 4 isolated full-agent A/B replay evaluation. Contains exact case messages and expectations only; run directories, session files, and DB paths are intentionally omitted.

cases.prompt: Same breakfast as yesterday. I ate it at 2026-08-18T08:15:00-07:00. Log it.
cases.expectation: Identify explicit exact reuse of stable prior entry_id 101 and write exactly one new row. Current path must use the durable writer identity; old path is scored as observed.

cases.prompt: Log my Morning plate recipe, exactly 1 serving, eaten at 2026-08-18T08:20:00-07:00.
cases.expectation: Use the canonical recipe candidate (300 kcal), not the historical meal with the same name (208 kcal), then write exactly one row.

cases.prompt: Log avacado toast for breakfast at 2026-08-18T08:25:00-07:00.
cases.expectation: Fuzzy/local history is only a candidate. Because bread type and portions are unspecified, ask one concise clarification and do not write.

cases.prompt: Log chicken rice bowl for lunch at 2026-08-18T12:00:00-07:00.
cases.expectation: Prior history is not proof of the same quantities. Ask one focused quantity/sameness clarification and do not write.

cases.prompt: Log a Chipotle chicken burrito bowl with white rice, black beans, fajita vegetables, mild tomato salsa, and cheese. I ate it at 2026-08-18T12:10:00-07:00.
cases.expectation: Perform a current published-source lookup (prefer official Chipotle), record the source, and use only the temporary DB. If the official source cannot provide a reliable total, ask whether to estimate or skip; never use model memory.

cases.prompt: Log one hard-boiled egg and one black coffee, no additions, eaten at 2026-08-18T08:30:00-07:00.
cases.expectation: Write this simple known meal. The exact delivery is replayed in a fresh session against the same temp DB; current path must be idempotent.
